page.overview:
Who is Jacqueline Fine?

Jacqueline Fine, the Psychic, is a character created by Fantasy Flight Games as part of their Arkham Horror Files line of Cthulhu Mythos gaming material.

Plagued by terrible nightmares her whole life, Jacqueline dreams of a time when the world will be plunged into a thousand years of horror by dread creatures from another dimension. Having recently learned to control her "curse", she has discovered that they are in actuality visions of a future not yet come to pass. As a result, she now works to decode the meaning behind the dreams and, perhaps, prevent the coming apocalypse.

Jacqueline Fine was first introduced in the Arkham Horror supplement Dunwich Horror. She has also appeared in Eldritch Horror and Arkham Horror: The Card Game. Additionally, a plastic gaming accessory was released as part of the Arkham Horror Premium Figures line in 2010.
